notes:
- Moved synchronized lyrics to a native scroll view that renders the visible rows and animates automatic scrolling with Core Animation.
- Fixed the flash and position jump when Instrumental ends. The countdown fades out while the next line smoothly moves into place and brightens.
- Streamlined switching between library sections by reusing groups and sort results. Offscreen artwork views release their images and cancel pending thumbnail work.

Requires macOS 27 or later on Apple silicon. The app archive is ad-hoc signed.
